ProductionBatch.name: ProductionBatch
ProductionBatch.description: Represents the batch of homogeneous products manufactured in the same production line.

BatchCreatedDate.description: The date and time when the production batch is created.

CreationLocationId.description: The ID of the location where the batch is created.

Description.description: The description of the production batch.

ExpirationDate.description: The date and time when the batch expires and is no longer usable.

IsActive.description: Indicates whether the production batch is active (true) or not (false).

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view.

ManufacturedDate.description: The manufactured date and time for the production batch.

ManufacturingLocationId.description: The ID of the manufacturing location of the production batch.

Name.description: The name of the production batch.

OriginType.description: Specifies the type of origin of the batch.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner or creator of this object.

ProductId.description: The product associated with the production batch.

QuantityUnitOfMeasure.description: Specifies the unit of measure for the products of the production batch.

UniqueIdentificationNumber.description: The unique identification number of the production batch. This field is unique within your organization.
